snippet.title: 4x4 in a Furniture Store DEMO Release Trailer
snippet.description:
A demo version of 4x4 in a Furniture Store is now available on Steam for Windows, Linux, and Mac!

Try out the unique mini-open-world offroad-but-its-indoors adventure today, and be sure to wishlist on steam to be notified when the full version releases!

Try the demo and wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4135570/4x4_in_a_Furniture_Store/
